test_title: PYST 36: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town whose current population of 1,40,000 is increasing at a rate of 25% every year?
solution:
**Given:**

Current population = 1,40,000

Rate of increase = 25% per year

**Formula used:**

Population after n years = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

Population before n years = P(1 + r/100)⁻ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Population 3 years ago:

⇒ P₃ yₑₐᵣₛ ₐgₒ = 1,40,000 × (1 + 25/100)⁻³

⇒ P&l
